title: Multiverse Gift Box: card flavor text

entities.name: Purraj of Urborg
entities.description: A figure of Urborg who accepts forbidden gifts.

entities.name: Zarkuu
entities.description: A necrosavant who remembers his first death.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: An ambitious, ruthless figure who boasts of his ambition and his pet that preys on minds.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: A people with diplomats and traditional wisdom about desert animals.

entities.name: Zhalfirin
entities.description: A people with desert guides and riddles.

events.summary: Ahmahz il Kin swears he is not lying during peace talks.
events.quote: "By the tongues of a thousand serpents, this time I do not lie."

events.summary: Purraj of Urborg tells a victim why he accepts forbidden gifts as they die.
events.quote: "As you breathe your last, understand why I accept such forbidden gifts."

events.summary: Kaervek threatens a victim with his pet mindsucker.
events.quote: "My pet will pick the ripe fruit from your tortured brain as if it were hanging from a vine."

events.summary: Kaervek declares blood on his hands is proof of his ambition.
events.quote: "The blood on my hands is merely proof of my ambition."

relations.note: Purraj is identified as being of Urborg
relations.quote: "As you breathe your last, understand why I accept such forbidden gifts."
